ORDINANCE VIII OF 2002
STAMP (BALOCHISTAN
2nd AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE
2002
ORDINANCE VIII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 8th April, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-35/Law/72, dated
8-4-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the- Governor of Balochistan
on 1st April, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Stamp (Balochistan 2nd
Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 2 of Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE VIII OF 2002
STAMP (BALOCHISTAN
2nd AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE
2002
ORDINANCE VIII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Stamp Act, 1899
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 8th April, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-35/Law/72, dated
8-4-2002.----The following Ordinance made by the- Governor of Balochistan
on 1st April, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act II of 1899.--In the Stamp Act, 1899, in sub-clause (b) of clause (9) of
section 2, for the words "Deputy Commissioner" the words
"Executive District Officer (Revenue)" shall be substituted.
